title: Called back from leave through a blizzard before Base 2 duty
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Called back from leave through a blizzard before Base 2 duty, about early 1990s at US, drive back to base, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And it was a blizzard. There was a blizzard the entire way home.

plain: A former US Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says he was hired to communicate with beings from elsewhere, says that in the early 1990s he was called back from leave before starting duty at a site he calls Base 2. He says he had to drive back through a blizzard the entire way home. It is part of his account of how his unusual secret posting began.
